For C2 rank-one-convex F on R^{2x2}, compatible jets are B1=[[a,b],[d,e]], B2=[[b,c],[e,f]], equivalently B1 e2=B2 e1. Set E_F=sum_i D2F(A)[Bi,Bi]. The source derives, at every fixed A, an algebraic two-form omega_A with E_F+omega_A(B1,B2)>=0 for all compatible jets, by imported univariate PSD matrix-polynomial SOS and the six quadratic minor relations. No smooth, polynomial or globally closed selection follows. Closed polynomial forms are exact and may integrate away in the established heat-flow interface; pointwise completion alone cannot.

In complex coordinates z=(A11+A22+i(A21-A12))/2, w=(A11-A22+i(A21+A12))/2, r=|z|,s=|w|,R=r+s, take F_p=((p-1)s-r)R^(p-1), p>2. On U={r,s>0}, Kp=2p(p-1)R^(p-2) and Omega=Kp(dz_R wedge dz_I+dw_R wedge dw_I) give the exact nonnegative square identity E_F+Omega=p(p-2)R^(p-3)[(p-1)s(a^2+b^2)+R^2((c-e)^2+(b-d)^2)/(4r)] after rotations. Nevertheless NO C1 closed two-form on all U gives such positivity for every compatible jet. Rotations and orientation-corrected conjugation reduce any candidate to rU dr wedge dtheta+rV ds wedge dtheta+sW dr wedge dphi+sZ ds wedge dphi. PSD null rows force U-V=Kp,W-Z=-Kp,Z=Kp,W=0, hence partial_r(sZ)-partial_s(sW)=2p(p-1)(p-2)sR^(p-3)>0. Constant anisotropic positive diffusion averages to the impossible isotropic certificate. This excludes that certificate class, not Burkholder quasiconvexity, nonlinear/nonlocal flows or integrated inequalities. Axis singularities do not repair an interior contradiction; p=2 gives -det A and no obstruction.

The determinant-square integrand is quasiconvex by the determinant null-Lagrangian identity and Jensen, but is not componentwise-heat monotone. On the 2pi torus h=sin x+sin y,v0=(h,h^2) has det Dv0=0. Its explicit heat evolution gives det Dvt=2e^-t(e^-2t-e^-4t)cos x cos y(sin x-sin y), with normalized mean (det Dvt)^2=0.5 e^-2t(e^-2t-e^-4t)^2>0. Thus a universal direct heat route for quartics fails, independently of exploratory numerics.

For homogeneous quartic POLYNOMIALS, Hessian reciprocity D2F(A)[H,H]=D2F(H)[A,A] makes the full Hessian PSD at rank-one matrices when F is rank-one convex. If additionally F vanishes on every rank-one matrix, divisibility and Euler identities force F=c(det A)^2,c>=0. This classifies only the rank-one-invisible ray, not all global completion obstructions. Define gamma_*(F)=inf_{rank H=1,Ddet(A)[H]!=0} D2F(A)[H,H]/[2(Ddet(A)[H])^2]. For gamma>=0, F-gamma det^2 is rank-one convex iff gamma<=gamma_*; examples gamma_*(det^2)=1 and gamma_*(|A|_F^4)=2. Determinant separation in the invariant class is credited prior work.

For quadratic-coefficient Omega, Euler/Cartan gives Omega_cl=(1/4)d(i_A Omega)=Omega-(1/4)i_A dOmega, globally exact. A sufficient positivity budget is E_G+Omega>=(1/4)|dOmega(A,B1,B2)|. Obtaining that budget, polynomial dependence or global closure is OPEN. Gate Q4 asks for EVERY rank-one-convex homogeneous quartic polynomial F whether some gamma in [0,gamma_*], constant M>0,tr M=2 and globally closed homogeneous-quadratic two-form omega make sum_ij Mij D2(F-gamma det^2)(A)[Bi,Bj]+omega_A(B1,B2)>=0 for all A and compatible jets. If true it would imply quasiconvexity throughout the 35-dimensional quartic coefficient space. It would not settle full planar Morrey or general Burkholder: degree-four homogeneity is not polynomiality, since F4 contains 8|z||w|^3. Sixty two-form coefficients and 15 closedness constraints leave 45; finite quantified algebra is not an efficient algorithm or a solved existence theorem. A failed finite SOS relaxation is not a counterexample.

Known rotationally invariant quartic heat/exact-form results, PSD matrix factorization and differential-form identities remain credited to their sources. This is a new variational compatibility family, not a continuation proof of N729 fluid regularity or an application of unrelated quartic spin cards. The obstruction and intermediate statements are source-reported proof candidates; Q4 remains unproved. Independent correctness, historical novelty, a major foundational completion and technological consequence remain UNKNOWN.
